sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: AMCLI revolutionized project initialization across the organization, generating 500+ projects with 100% code consistency. The CLI reduced setup time by 94% (from 4 hours to 15 minutes) while enforcing best practices and eliminating configuration errors that previously cost teams days of debugging.

sections.title: CLI Success
highlights: 500+ projects generated with consistent structure and configuration
94% reduction in project setup time (4 hours → 15 minutes)
100% code consistency score across all generated projects
Zero configuration errors from copy-paste mistakes

sections.title: Business Results
sections.summary: AMCLI transformed new developer onboarding from a multi-day process to hours. Teams no longer waste time on boilerplate configuration, allowing developers to focus on business logic from day one. The standardized project structure also simplified code reviews and cross-team collaboration.

businessValue: Reduced project setup time by 80% (from 4 hours to 15 minutes)
